label: About
title: About Under the Lemon Arch
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 8 source windows around Portable Void, by Imaginary Softwoods and Feet Like Fins, plus 6 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Under the Lemon Arch: A living botanical field in fashion/material macro: oblique close-up through a wet refracting surface. Gather hooked, pleated lemon-chartreuse leaves into an oversized arch cropped upper right; recess a smaller branching lilac flower mass lower left across a broad olive passage. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 8 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Hooked yellow-green leaf with an olive interior, Translucent lilac bell-flower lobes, and Doubled pale edge on the right-hand leaf fold.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
